name: aria-live
description: Build what your Twitch chat votes for: wait for the streamer-approved task, claim it, report progress to the stream overlay and finish it.

interface.shortDescription: Build what your Twitch chat votes for, live
interface.longDescription: Twitch viewers pitch ideas with !idea and vote with !vote. The streamer approves the winning task on the Aria Live dashboard; Codex waits for it, claims it, builds it in your repository and every milestone shows on the stream overlay. Codex can never approve a task itself, and viewer text is treated as untrusted input.
defaultPrompt: Build the task my Twitch chat voted for
What is my Aria Live round doing right now?
